Our Heritage & Philosophy

A Harmony of Indian Culinary Tradition & Garden Elegance

Established in 2012 by Hotel Chaudhari Garden, our venue was created with a singular passion: bringing people together over authentic Indian curries, tandoori specialties, and refreshing open-air garden dining.

Every dish is crafted using fresh local ingredients, pure ghee, and whole spices ground daily in our kitchen. From sizzling tandoori starters to rich paneer gravies and kulhad lassi, we celebrate Indian culinary warmth in every bite.

Chef's Credo

"Indian hospitality is rooted in Atithi Devo Bhava — honoring every guest with pure ingredients, rich authentic spices, and heartfelt warmth."

— Chef Ramesh Chaudhari
